title: Krynite Server Modpack
description: A lightweight peaceful server focused modpack. Features Create, Origins, Farmer's Delight, and QoL improvements. Designed around Krynite.
body:
# Krynite Server Modpack!

Krynite is a lightweight multiplayer server designed for a long term survival experience without the overwhelming effects of hundreds of complex mods.
The pack focuses on creating a playable foundation for the server whilst maintaining a solid performance for low end PCs.

### Features

- Create and several Create add-ons.
- Origins.
- Farmer's Delight and Nether's Delight.
- QoL improvements and optimisation mods.

### FAQ

> **Q: Is Krynite multiplayer?**
>
> **A:** Yes, the modpack is intended for use in [Krynite](https://discord.gg/84nuAc6hv2).

> **Q: Can I use this modpack for other servers?**
> 
> **A:** Yeah! This pack is made for Krynite but isn't exclusive to it.

> **Q: Is there a Krynite Discord Server?**
>
> **A:** The link is here: `https://discord.gg/84nuAc6hv2`

> **Q: Why use this pack?**
>
> **A:** Well, this pack is made for use in Krynite so in order to play on Krynite this pack must be used. However you may also use this pack for another server with your friends!

## Additional Information

This modpack contains the essential mods needed to play the server, along with QoL and Optimisation mods. You could add your own mods to make your experience better!
